interactables.title: Harbourgate Notice Board
interactables.subtitle: Public Bulletins · Harbourgate Lane
lines: SHIPPING LEDGER: Three merchant hulls berthed across West, Central Shipyard, and East Piers; outbound tide opens at dusk.
FOUNDRY NOTICE: West Forge & Assay Office now open on Refinery Avenue for ingot stamping and furnace tours.
BAZAAR BULLETIN: Southgate Arcade now opens straight onto South Bazaar Boulevard—visit the Weaver and Vintner Guildhalls.

interactables.title: Mana Conduit Manifold
interactables.subtitle: Aetheric Conduit & Horology Workshop
lines: Heavy iron housing fitted with braided copper feed-pipes and a glowing cyan pressure sight-glass.
Regulates external mana drawn from the West Industrial Quarter to power Harbourgate street lamps and precision workshop lathes.

interactables.title: Chandlery Customs Counter
interactables.subtitle: Vaelcrest Customs & Chandlery
lines: Stamped brass seals, coil-rope manifests, and copper-lined ledgers line the timber counter.
Merchants register hull drafts and bonded warehouse space here before ascending toward Copperwell Square.

interactables.title: The Salt & Brass Taproom
interactables.subtitle: Sailors Taproom · Harbourgate Lane
lines: Warm hearth smoke and polished copper taps welcome dockworkers, carters, and merchant crews off the quays.
Chalked above the bar: "House Vaelcrest Harbor Toll Paid — No Live Mana Coils Beside the Hearth."

interactables.title: Copperwell Cistern Fountain
interactables.subtitle: Copperwell Public Square
lines: An octagonal sandstone basin crowned with a copper bowl and a suspended cyan mana-regulator crystal.
External mana keeps groundwater circulating cleanly for the surrounding apothecary, bookbinder, and townhouse blocks.

interactables.title: Courtyard Iron Water Pump
interactables.subtitle: Worker Tenement Courtyard
lines: A well-worn cast-iron hand pump set into a sunken sandstone trough, serving dozens of tenement households.
Rust stains and stacked cargo barrels mark the daily rhythm of the working-class quarter behind Harbourgate Lane.

interactables.title: Quay Customs Manifest Desk
interactables.subtitle: Grand Harbour Quay Booth
lines: QUAY BERTH LOG: West Pier unloading oak timber; Central Shipyard Pier fitting brigantine rudders; East Pier loading mana canisters.
VIADUCT FREIGHT: Elevated mana locomotive runs continuously between Mariners Guildhall and Heavy Boiler Works.

interactables.title: Mana-Railway Viaduct Arch
interactables.subtitle: Grand Harbour Infrastructure
lines: Massive dressed-stone piers support the 5.8-metre rail deck carrying external-mana freight trains above the harbourfront.
A copper central conductor rail runs between the iron tracks, feeding traction power directly to passing locomotives.

interactables.title: West Pier Merchantman Berth
interactables.subtitle: West Cargo Pier · Grand Harbour
lines: Deep-draft timber merchantman moored fast to iron bollards, fitted with a glowing cyan stern mana-propulsion fin.
Crane crews swing copper-banded cargo crates directly between the pier apron and the ship hold.

interactables.title: Flagship Anchor Monument
interactables.subtitle: Central Shipyard Pier · Grand Harbour
lines: A two-ton wrought-iron bower anchor with copper cross-stock mounted beside coils of tarred hemp cable.
Commemorates House Vaelcrest’s opening of the Central Shipyard Pier and expanded Elarion drydocks.

interactables.title: East Pier Harbour Beacon
interactables.subtitle: East Cargo Pier · Grand Harbour
lines: Sandstone signal tower housing a high-output cyan mana lantern that guides vessels past Elarion’s outer breakwaters.
From the pier head, incoming tall-masted cargo ships tack steadily across the bay.

interactables.title: Industrial Mana Substation
interactables.subtitle: West Industrial Quarter
lines: Three cyan sight-gauges hum steadily beneath heavy overhead copper mains linking directly to the storage silos.
You calibrate the bypass valve and record the pressure reading — ready to synthesize a Stabilized Crystal Core ([B]).

interactables.title: External Mana Storage Silos
interactables.subtitle: West Refinery Yard
lines: Four riveted iron pressure cylinders banded with copper ribs hold refined liquid-state external mana.
Pressurized overhead mains feed both Heavy Boiler Works to the west and the Grand Harbour cranes north.

interactables.title: Mana-Heated Crucible Furnace
interactables.subtitle: Smelting Hall · Industrial Quarter
lines: Radiant heat pours from an arched brick furnace stoked by focused external-mana coils rather than coal.
Refined bronze and Vaelcrest iron ingots cast here forge viaduct rails, crane sheaves, and astrolabe rings.

interactables.title: West Forge & Assay Bench
interactables.subtitle: Accessible Assay Office · Refinery Ave
lines: Precision copper balance pans, hallmark punches, and warm hearth tongs sit ready for grading smelted ingots.
Only bars carrying the Vaelcrest purity stamp qualify for high-pressure viaduct and mana-silo castings.

interactables.title: Southgate Market Obelisk
interactables.subtitle: Artisan Market Plaza
lines: Carved sandstone market standard marking the heart of Elarion’s ten-stall open-air bazaar.
Pass south through the arched gallery below to enter the Weaver and Vintner halls on South Bazaar Boulevard.

interactables.title: Weaver’s Guild Silk Display
interactables.subtitle: South Bazaar Boulevard · West
lines: Bolts of teal, crimson, and saffron cloth sit beside hammered copper dye-urns outside the Weaver’s Guildhall.
Sea-windproof wool woven here outfits both Vaelcrest sailors and Noble Heights diplomats.

interactables.title: Vintner’s Guild Reserve Casks
interactables.subtitle: South Bazaar Boulevard · East
lines: Iron-hooped oak casks branded with the Suncoast grape seal await cartage up Harbourgate Lane.
Thick brick cellar walls keep vintages cool even beneath midday sun.

interactables.title: Aetheric Botany Conservatory
interactables.subtitle: Academic Courtyard · North Wing
lines: A copper-ribbed glass atrium crowning limestone halls where coastal herbs and dye-blossoms grow year-round.
Gentle external-mana lamps warm the upper glass dome through harbour fog.

interactables.title: Aetheric Brass Astrolabe
interactables.subtitle: Academic Quarter Courtyard
lines: Three concentric copper-and-iron armillary rings orbit a suspended cyan mana crystal above an octagonal limestone plinth.
Scholars use it to align harbour navigation beacons and measure regional aetheric tide shifts.

interactables.title: Academic Observatory & Archive
interactables.subtitle: Academic Quarter Courtyard
lines: A copper-domed limestone tower crowned with an iron celestial spyglass overlooking Elarion Bay.
Beside it stand the Grand Archive Hall and South Cartography Hall housing regional sea charts.

interactables.title: South Cartography Hall
interactables.subtitle: Academic Courtyard · South Wing
lines: Windowed limestone drafting hall where guild cartographers survey soundings, breakwater depths, and rail spurs.

interactables.title: House Vaelcrest Council Crest
interactables.subtitle: Noble Heights Upper Plaza
lines: An engraved limestone stele inlaid with the copper crest of House Vaelcrest before the colonnade of the Council Dome Hall.
Flanked north by Lord Vaelcrest’s Manor Wing and south by the Chancery & Diplomatic Rotunda.

interactables.title: Noble Heights City Overlook
interactables.subtitle: Noble Heights Terrace · 5.2m Elevation
lines: From the elevated limestone balustrade, all five districts of Elarion spread out in clear relief:
Three Harbour piers and viaduct north, Boiler Works & West Forge west, Market & Bazaar Boulevard south, Academic towers below.

interactables.title: Three-Council Rotunda & Lecterns
interactables.subtitle: Castle Vaelcrest · Great Hall
lines: Seat of the Council of Law, the Council of Authority, and the quarterly Council of Elders beneath House Vaelcrest’s copper dome.
Though founded after the first Warrior Lord’s era, the councils allow talented commoners to rise to mayors, ministers, and commanders.

interactables.title: Domain Strategic Relief Map
interactables.subtitle: Castle Vaelcrest · Patriarch War Room
lines: A carved scale relief of the entire 230,000 km² Vaelcrest Domain—showing Elarion’s bay, inland rail corridors, agricultural valleys, and mountain strongholds.

interactables.title: North Sea-Cliff Mana-Railgun Battery
interactables.subtitle: Castle Vaelcrest · Rampart Battlements (11.4m)
lines: Twin-rail external-mana cannon emplacements sweep across Elarion Bay, backed by glowing capacitor coils and the Aetheric Communication Spire.

interactables.title: House Vaelcrest Knight Training Yard
interactables.subtitle: Castle Vaelcrest · Outer Bailey
lines: Commoner recruits and noble squires spar side by side beneath the crimson Vaelcrest banner—advancement here depends strictly on skill and valor.

interactables.title: Grand Canal Lock Bridge
interactables.subtitle: Central Waterway Artery
lines: Three stone arch bridges span Elarion’s Grand Canal basin, linking harbour refineries directly to the Merchant Quarter.
External-mana cargo barges carry refined crystals and machined goods inland toward the railway freight yards.

interactables.title: Temple Quarter Nave & Basin
interactables.subtitle: Temple Quarter · NW Terrace
lines: A gabled stone sanctuary with a copper bell-steeple and carved stone cloisters frames Elarion’s reflection basin.
Built over generations by harbour stonewrights, the sanctuary welcomes citizens from every fief in the Domain.

interactables.title: Mana Works Condenser Towers
interactables.subtitle: Industrial Quarter & Mana Works
lines: Paired 34-meter cooling towers regulate pressure for Elarion’s heavy machinery, munitions foundries, and mana storage tanks.

interactables.title: Grand Exchange Square & Compass Fountain
interactables.subtitle: Heart of the Merchant Quarter
lines: This open maritime plaza and brass compass monument anchor Elarion’s banking, shipping finance, and overseas trade.
Westward lie residential neighbourhoods and civic schools; eastward stand the Reserve Bank Clocktower and Clearing House.

interactables.title: Domain Overland Bastion Gate
interactables.subtitle: Highway & Rail Link to Vaelcrest Domain
lines: Twin rampart towers and mana barrier pylons stand at the inland gateway connecting Elarion to agricultural plains, mines, and highlands.

interactables.title: Grand Harbour Viaduct Terminal
interactables.subtitle: Coastal Viaduct Line · Ticket Terminal
lines: Elevated copper-conductor deck overlooking the three cargo piers and shipyards.

interactables.title: Temple Quarter Cloister Stop
interactables.subtitle: Coastal Viaduct Line · Ticket Terminal
lines: North-west sanctuary platform linking cathedral stone cloisters to the harbour viaduct.

interactables.title: Mana Works & Freight Yard
interactables.subtitle: Inland Exchange Spur · Ticket Terminal
lines: Heavy traction switching yard beneath the twin condenser towers and rolling mill.

interactables.title: Grand Exchange Terminus
interactables.subtitle: Inland Exchange Spur · Ticket Terminal
lines: Central passenger exchange beside the Reserve Bank Clocktower and Compass Fountain.

interactables.title: Council Heights Express Station
interactables.subtitle: Coastal Viaduct Line · Ticket Terminal
lines: Upper terrace express terminus serving the Three Councils Assembly Hall and Citadel.

interactables.title: Bastion Overland Railhead
interactables.subtitle: Inland Exchange Spur · Ticket Terminal
lines: Southern domain gateway departing toward agricultural plains, mines, and emerald wilds.

interactables.title: Aetheric Mana Shard
interactables.subtitle: Harbourgate Lane · Unrefined Conduit Crystal
lines: A palm-sized cyan conduit crystal dropped beside the Harbourgate lantern curb, humming with external mana.

interactables.title: Vaelcrest Customs Seal
interactables.subtitle: Vaelcrest Chandlery · Bonded Brass Coffer
lines: An official wax-stamped customs coffer clearing dry-dock timber for the Central Shipyard Pier.

interactables.title: Apothecary Herb Satchel
interactables.subtitle: Copperwell Square · Clinic Field Kit
lines: A woven satchel packed with dried coastal sea-fennel and a stoppered tonic phial.

interactables.title: Harbourmaster Dispatch
interactables.subtitle: Grand Harbour Quay · Sealed Pier Orders
lines: Rolled parchment bearing tide-gate timings for the West and East Cargo Piers.

interactables.title: Shipwright Brass Astrolabe
interactables.subtitle: Central Shipyard Pier · Navigation Instrument
lines: A calibrated twin-ring brass astrolabe used to align brigantine compass binnacles.

interactables.title: Assayed Copper Ingot Stack
interactables.subtitle: Refinery Avenue · Foundry Lot #14
lines: Three freshly cast copper-bronze ingots stamped for the elevated viaduct conductor rail.

interactables.title: Refined Crucible Mana Core
interactables.subtitle: Smelting Hall · West Industrial Quarter
lines: A high-output aetheric core stabilized in a cast-iron collar for furnace ignition.

interactables.title: Bazaar Guild Charter Box
interactables.subtitle: Artisan Market Plaza · Southgate
lines: Stallholder dues chest sealed in crimson wax for the Weaver and Vintner guilds.

interactables.title: Calibration Armillary Ring
interactables.subtitle: Academic Courtyard · Observatory Terrace
lines: Precision scholarly armillary instrument tuned to Elarion’s harbour beacons.

interactables.title: Chancery Diplomatic Folio
interactables.subtitle: Noble Heights Plaza · Upper Terrace
lines: Gilded diplomatic dispatches bound for House Vaelcrest’s Council Dome Hall.

interactables.title: Three-Council Charter Roll
interactables.subtitle: Castle Vaelcrest · Great Hall
lines: Gilded legislative folio countersigned by the Council of Law and Council of Authority.

interactables.title: Royal Treasury Reserve Signet
interactables.subtitle: Castle Vaelcrest · Treasury Vault
lines: Heavy brass reserve seal locking Crown bullion shipments to the Vaelcrest Reserve Bank.

interactables.title: Canal Freight Lock Ledger
interactables.subtitle: Central Canal Bridge · Crest
lines: Dispatch tallying external-mana barge shipments bound for Elarion’s Merchant Quarter.

interactables.title: Sanctuary Chime Prism
interactables.subtitle: Temple Quarter · Reflection Basin
lines: A resonant pale-blue crystal calibrated to chime quietly across the sanctuary cloisters.

interactables.title: Railgun Alloy Forging
interactables.subtitle: Mana Works · Rolling Mill
lines: High-density copper-steel bar cast for Citadel railgun barrels and railway axles.

interactables.title: Reserve Bank Bullion Seal
interactables.subtitle: Merchant Quarter · Exchange Square
lines: Stamped maritime lending coffer certifying overseas investment credit in Elarion.

interactables.title: Civic Field Survey Kit
interactables.subtitle: West Residential · Guild School
lines: Satchel packed with field notebooks and apothecary tonics issued to civic apprentices.

interactables.title: Exchange Meridian Chronometer
interactables.subtitle: East Merchant Ward · Clearing House
lines: Precision chronometer synchronizing maritime shipping ledgers with inland rail departures.

interactables.title: Barrier Pylon Capacitor
interactables.subtitle: Overland Bastion Rampart
lines: Sealed external-mana capacitor cell powering Elarion’s southern defensive barrier pylons.

interactables.title: Copperwell Alchemist Bench
interactables.subtitle: Alchemy Bench · Tonics & Phials
lines: Step close to the Copperwell Alchemist Bench and press [B] to unlock ALCHEMY crafting recipes.

interactables.subtitle: Runesmith Forge · Weapons & Armor
lines: Step close to the Smelting Hall Runesmith Forge and press [B] to unlock FORGE crafting recipes.

lines: Step close to the West Forge Runesmith Anvil and press [B] to unlock FORGE crafting recipes.

interactables.subtitle: Ley-Shrine · Relics & Synthesis
lines: Step close to the Temple Quarter Ley-Shrine and press [B] to unlock SHRINE crafting recipes.

interactables.title: Emerald Glade Ley-Shrine
interactables.subtitle: Ley-Shrine · Relics & Synthesis
lines: Step close to the Emerald Glade Ley-Shrine and press [B] to unlock SHRINE crafting recipes.

interactables.title: Ancient Vaelcrest Ley-Portal
interactables.subtitle: Emerald Wilds · Epicenter
lines: A towering runic arch humming with raw Aetheric current. Vanquish the Crystal Wyrm guarding this threshold to restore the Emerald Wilds.
